text: 1、市场全天震荡调整，三大指数集体下挫。影视股逆势大涨，儒意电影2连板，上海电影、欢瑞世纪涨停。医药股持续反弹，哈药股份5连板，片仔癀、海南海药等涨停。下跌方面，半导体芯片股调整，兆易创新、长电科技、德明利等多股跌停；算力硬件股走弱，华工科技、中国巨石、中材科技等跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市约2900股飘绿，今日成交2.42万亿。截止收盘沪指跌1.85%，深成指跌1.97%，创业板指跌2.95%。 2、板块概念方面，影视短剧、医药医疗、猪肉、旅游等板块涨幅居前，半导体芯片、算力硬件、油气、煤炭等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共2344只个股上涨，46只个股涨
text_en: 1. The market saw a full-day adjustment, with all three major indices falling. Film and television stocks rose sharply, with Ruyi Film (HKG: after removing cross-market, unclear ticker) hitting the 2-board limit, and Shanghai Film (601595) and Huanrui Century (000892) hitting limit up. Pharmaceutical stocks continued to rebound, with Harbin Pharmaceutical (600664) hitting 5 consecutive limit ups, and Pian Zai Huang (600436) and Hainan Haiyao (000566) among limit ups. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks adjusted, with GigaDevice, JCET (600584), and Demili (300245) among many hitting limit down; computing hardware stocks weakened, with HGLaser (000988), China Jushi (600176), and Sinoma Science & Technology (002080) hitting limit down. More stocks fell than rose, with about 2900 stocks declining across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing, with today's turnover at 2.42 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.85%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.97%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.95%. 2. By sector concept, film and TV short dramas, pharmaceuticals and healthcare, pork, and tourism led gains, while semiconductor chips, computing hardware, oil and gas, and coal led losses. 3. A total of 2344 stocks rose across两市, with 46 stocks up.
